svg.title: The Inner Sound
svg.desc: North-up regional blockout. Active boats connect Keld, Orren, Verran and Selwick. Restricted passages reach Sere from Orren and Anset from Selwick. The Outer Bar is beyond Selwick.
svg.text: Passages between the four inhabited islands and the two low-water landings
Heavy freight uses the low berth.
The wall has a lee and a surf face.
A sill and gutter emerge at ebb.
The skiff floats over the shell bed.
Offshore breakers mark the eastern limit.
Coastlines show relative position and relief. Ferry crossings take part of a watch.
